We've been a tea-drinking family for ever. So, when a friend gave me her coffee maker - a Mr Coffee DW13, 12 cup, no filters - I thought sure, it's nice to have around for guests but it probably won't be used much. Boy was I wrong.

I started to think... did I want to add to the garbage we already generate? So I opted for the reusable filter.
After reading a bunch of online descriptions and some reviews, I came across this one. I ordered it, and have never looked back.

It fits the coffee maker (priority one), filters coffee great - we use fine and coarse ground - it's super easy to clean and dry, and it doesn't retain the coffee smell! Which is great if you stuff it into a drawer, and don't want your cutlery to have that old coffee smell.

Glad we purchased it!

The original manufacturer is out of stock or not carrying the replacement for this basket. I got this as a substitute when my spouse accidentally threw out the original basket with the recycling.

For the most part it's a good substitute. The only thing that annoys me is that the original had a bit of a ledge on the rim for the basket handle to rest in when in use. This basket doesn't have one, or if they tried it doesn't work. The little handle frequently slides down into the basket. I'm almost tempted to take the handle off, but since it doesn't seem to affect the brewing process, I've not done it.

Considering the original manufacturer isn't providing one -- out of stock or not being made -- this seems a pretty good alternative.

I am having a hard time finding paper filters (the ones that need to be used on this model).... But the mesh did not allow the water to drain into the pot fast enough, so the water backed up and leaked out all over the coffee maker and onto  the counter. About 1/2 of the water in a 12 cup pot ever made it into the pot. So total failure.  But on the other hand if I use it over a coffee pot  and manually add water, the slow pass through rate results in a stronger cup of coffee. I am very happy with this product, but I would encourage shoppers to look carefully at the picture of what you are buying first. There are a lot of black refrigerator door handles out there, that have very different sizes and shapes. I found it easy to order incorrectly, and the product descriptions don't always help to make things clear. Take a good look at what you have, take careful measurements, and make sure that the picture matches what you need.
